name: 8539-batchdecode-dsv2lite-dp8
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat. Ungated, ~31 GB of bf16 safetensors in four shards, already in the local HF cache.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, ONE node, all eight cards, NVLink4.
parallelism: tp8 with data-parallel attention at dp8 (dp-size == tp-size, so each rank's attention group is a single GPU and each rank owns its own requests' tokens and its own share of the KV pool); the dense MLP and the MoE stay tensor-parallel across the same eight ranks. EP=1, PP=1.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, 15.7B total / 2.4B active in bf16, 27 layers, hidden 2048. MLA attention at kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64, so one 576-wide latent row per token per layer and 30.4 KiB of KV per token; MoE with 64 routed + 2 shared experts, top-6. The rest is readable off the checkpoint's config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=1024 -- 128 per DP rank -- warmup the first 10%, bounded at 2048 requests with a 3600 s safety cap, seed 42.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, SINGLE TURN, no shared prefix, sent to /v1/completions: exactly 1024 prompt tokens and exactly 1024 generated tokens per request (both stdev 0), `ignore_eos: true`, `temperature: 0.0`, responses streamed. Every rank therefore carries an equal token count.
purpose: A long-form chat assistant streaming 1024-token replies to 1024 concurrent users on eight H100s.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Keys are passed through as launch arguments, one `key: value` per
# line; an indented block is dropped silently, so a structured value must stay on ONE line.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat

# The checkpoint ships its own configuration and modeling modules.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 8

# dp-size is mandatory rather than derived: the engine asserts dp_size > 1 whenever dp attention
# is on. Eight and only eight -- below tp-size the attention group is no longer a single rank,
# which is a different deployment.
enable-dp-attention: true
dp-size: 8

# LOAD-BEARING, NOT COSMETIC: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions and the engine sizes a
# device-side int32 req_to_token table of (max requests + 1) x (context length + 4) from this.
context-length: 4096

# Slightly above the value the engine derives here (0.78 at tp8 with dp attention), pinned rather
# than derived per run.
mem-fraction-static: 0.81

# What the engine's own auto-selector reaches for MLA on Hopper at this commit; written down so
# backend selection cannot drift underneath the run.
attention-backend: fa3

random-seed: 42
